question: Jimmy starts from point A and drives 6 km towards the South. He then takes two simultaneous left turns and drives 4 km and 6 km, respectively. He then takes a final right turn and drives 4 km to reach point B. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees only unless specified.)
solution:
Given, 

Jimmy starts from point A and drives 6 km towards the South.

He then takes two simultaneous left turns and drives 4 km and 6 km, respectively.

He then takes a final right turn and drives 4 km to reach point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9190d13845200f74fc92cbbf24c3a3cecd66d6ae93243d3bc9968cb214a2ee2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d9167cbcabd3c35f793e6c65274cbdf3eb7c9d77308ce2739bc9d456ab459ba.png] 

He should drive **8 km toward West **to reach Point A again.

Hence the correct answer is **Option 4.**
